reasons: Claimed status is compliant with no redline and no comment, which is the expected output for a compliant finding; the rendered redline is identical to the original paragraphs.

The cited paragraphs (Section 7.3 supply pricing set by a specified formula; Section 9.3(a) fixed royalty rates) contain no most-favoured-nation, 'no less favourable', or third-party price-matching language, so no MFN obligation burdens Sanofi (our party) — this matches the preferred position of no Customer MFN obligation.
Rationale accurately describes the sweep performed and correctly notes that a Vendor-granted MFN would also be acceptable but none exists; no deterministic check failures.
